title: Reliance on others
description: How much of your month other people carry: what they paid for, the support income you received, and what the months would look like without it.

list.name: cur_month
list.label: This month
list.description: Feeds the links to the Ledger; not shown.
list.query: select to_char(max(month_start), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(max(month_start), 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan
list.definition: select to_char(max(month_start), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(max(month_start), 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan

panels.title: Last full month
panels.description: What others paid for, as a share of everything bought for you, and the support income that reached chequing, as a share of that income. The other dashboards count only what you paid.

targets.rawSql:
select
  s.external_spend as "Paid by others",
  s.external_spend / nullif(s.spend + s.external_spend, 0) as "Share of what was bought",
  coalesce(x.support, 0) as "Support income",
  coalesce(x.support, 0) / nullif(s.spendable_income, 0) as "Share of income"
from marts.fct_monthly_summary s
left join (
  select f.month_start, sum(f.amount) as support from marts.fct_transactions f where f.type = 'income' and f.is_support and f.deposit_account_name is null group by 1
) x on x.month_start = s.month_start
where s.month_start = (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month)

matcher.options: ^(Share of what was bought|Share of income)$

panels.title: Who paid, by month
panels.description: Everything bought for you each month, split by whose money paid. * marks the month in progress.

targets.rawSql:
select to_char(p.month_start, 'Mon YY') || case when p.is_complete_month then '' else '*' end as month, s.spend as "You", s.external_spend as "Others"
from (select * from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc limit 13) p
join marts.fct_monthly_summary s on s.month_start = p.month_start
order by p.month_start

panels.title: What others paid for, last 6 full months
panels.description: The categories others paid toward, as a monthly mean. Share of the category is their part of everything bought in it. Click a category for the line items.

targets.rawSql:
select "Category", "Paid by others a month", "Share of the category" from (
  select f.category_name as "Category",
    sum(f.amount) filter (where not f.is_self_funded) / 6 as "Paid by others a month",
    sum(f.amount) filter (where not f.is_self_funded) / sum(f.amount) as "Share of the category"
  from marts.fct_transactions f
  where f.type = 'expense'
    and f.month_start > (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month) - interval '6 months' and f.month_start <= (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month)
  group by f.category_name
) x
where "Paid by others a month" > 0
order by 2 desc, 1
limit 9

panels.title: Income by month, support and the rest
panels.description: The income that reached chequing each month, split into support income and everything else. * marks the month in progress.

targets.rawSql:
select to_char(p.month_start, 'Mon YY') || case when p.is_complete_month then '' else '*' end as month,
  s.spendable_income - coalesce(x.support, 0) as "Other income",
  coalesce(x.support, 0) as "Support income"
from (select * from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc limit 13) p
join marts.fct_monthly_summary s on s.month_start = p.month_start
left join (
  select f.month_start, sum(f.amount) as support from marts.fct_transactions f where f.type = 'income' and f.is_support and f.deposit_account_name is null group by 1
) x on x.month_start = p.month_start
order by p.month_start

panels.title: Support income by period
panels.description: Monthly means over each period. Financial future is what you set aside; Without support is what would have been left to set aside had the support income not come, so a minus means your spending alone was more than your own income. Same spending; support income removed, and financial future takes the loss.

targets.rawSql:
with w as (
  select r.window_months as n, r.spendable_income, r.needs_spend, r.wants_spend, r.financial_future, r.unallocated_cash,
    coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where f.type = 'income' and f.is_support and f.deposit_account_name is null), 0) as support,
    coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where f.type = 'expense' and not f.is_self_funded and f.bucket = 'needs'), 0) as others_needs,
    coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where f.type = 'expense' and not f.is_self_funded and f.bucket = 'wants'), 0) as others_wants
  from marts.fct_month_rolling r
  left join marts.fct_transactions f
    on f.month_start > r.month_start - make_interval(months => r.window_months) and f.month_start <= r.month_start
  where r.month_start = (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month)
  group by r.window_months, r.spendable_income, r.needs_spend, r.wants_spend, r.financial_future, r.unallocated_cash
),
t as (
  select needs_target_pct, wants_target_pct, financial_future_target_pct
  from marts.fct_monthly_summary order by month_start desc limit 1
)
select
  'Last ' || w.n || ' full months' as "Period",
  w.spendable_income / w.n as "Income a month",
  case when w.spendable_income is not null then w.support / w.n end as "Support a month",
  w.support / nullif(w.spendable_income, 0) as "Share of income",
  w.financial_future / w.n as "Financial future",
  case when ((w.financial_future - w.support) / w.n) > 0 then '+$' when ((w.financial_future - w.support) / w.n) < 0 then '−$' else '$' end || to_char(abs(round(((w.financial_future - w.support) / w.n))), 'FM999999990') as "Without support"
from w
order by w.n

panels.title: Bucket shares with and without support income
panels.description: The last 3 full months: each bucket as a share of the income that reached chequing. Without support keeps your needs and wants, takes support income out of the income, and leaves financial future with what remains; a minus there means spending alone was more than your own income. Same spending; support income removed, and financial future takes the loss.

targets.rawSql:
with w as (
  select r.window_months as n, r.spendable_income, r.needs_spend, r.wants_spend, r.financial_future, r.unallocated_cash,
    coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where f.type = 'income' and f.is_support and f.deposit_account_name is null), 0) as support,
    coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where f.type = 'expense' and not f.is_self_funded and f.bucket = 'needs'), 0) as others_needs,
    coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where f.type = 'expense' and not f.is_self_funded and f.bucket = 'wants'), 0) as others_wants
  from marts.fct_month_rolling r
  left join marts.fct_transactions f
    on f.month_start > r.month_start - make_interval(months => r.window_months) and f.month_start <= r.month_start
  where r.month_start = (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month)
  group by r.window_months, r.spendable_income, r.needs_spend, r.wants_spend, r.financial_future, r.unallocated_cash
),
t as (
  select needs_target_pct, wants_target_pct, financial_future_target_pct
  from marts.fct_monthly_summary order by month_start desc limit 1
)
select b.name as "Bucket", b.amount / w.n as "A month",
  b.amount / nullif(w.spendable_income, 0) as "As logged",
  b.amount_without / nullif(w.spendable_income - w.support, 0) as "Without support",
  b.target as "Target"
from w cross join t
cross join lateral (values
  (1, 'Needs', w.needs_spend, w.needs_spend, t.needs_target_pct),
  (2, 'Wants', w.wants_spend, w.wants_spend, t.wants_target_pct),
  (3, 'Financial future', w.financial_future, w.financial_future - w.support, t.financial_future_target_pct),
  (4, 'Unallocated', w.unallocated_cash, w.unallocated_cash, 0)
) as b (ord, name, amount, amount_without, target)
where w.n = 3
order by b.ord

panels.title: Income this lifestyle needs, counting what others paid
panels.description: The monthly income at which everything bought for you, by you or by others, would fit your targets: needs and wants each at most their target share. Spare is your income without support less that figure. Same spending; support income removed, and financial future takes the loss.

targets.rawSql:
with w as (
  select r.window_months as n, r.spendable_income, r.needs_spend, r.wants_spend, r.financial_future, r.unallocated_cash,
    coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where f.type = 'income' and f.is_support and f.deposit_account_name is null), 0) as support,
    coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where f.type = 'expense' and not f.is_self_funded and f.bucket = 'needs'), 0) as others_needs,
    coalesce(sum(f.amount) filter (where f.type = 'expense' and not f.is_self_funded and f.bucket = 'wants'), 0) as others_wants
  from marts.fct_month_rolling r
  left join marts.fct_transactions f
    on f.month_start > r.month_start - make_interval(months => r.window_months) and f.month_start <= r.month_start
  where r.month_start = (select max(month_start) from marts.fct_month_plan where is_complete_month)
  group by r.window_months, r.spendable_income, r.needs_spend, r.wants_spend, r.financial_future, r.unallocated_cash
),
t as (
  select needs_target_pct, wants_target_pct, financial_future_target_pct
  from marts.fct_monthly_summary order by month_start desc limit 1
)
select
  'Last ' || w.n || ' full months' as "Period",
  (w.needs_spend + w.others_needs) / w.n as "Needs a month",
  (w.wants_spend + w.others_wants) / w.n as "Wants a month",
  greatest((w.needs_spend + w.others_needs) / nullif(t.needs_target_pct, 0), (w.wants_spend + w.others_wants) / nullif(t.wants_target_pct, 0)) / w.n as "Income needed",
  (w.spendable_income - w.support) / w.n as "Income without support",
  case when ((w.spendable_income - w.support - greatest((w.needs_spend + w.others_needs) / nullif(t.needs_target_pct, 0), (w.wants_spend + w.others_wants) / nullif(t.wants_target_pct, 0))) / w.n) > 0 then '+$' when ((w.spendable_income - w.support - greatest((w.needs_spend + w.others_needs) / nullif(t.needs_target_pct, 0), (w.wants_spend + w.others_wants) / nullif(t.wants_target_pct, 0))) / w.n) < 0 then '−$' else '$' end || to_char(abs(round(((w.spendable_income - w.support - greatest((w.needs_spend + w.others_needs) / nullif(t.needs_target_pct, 0), (w.wants_spend + w.others_wants) / nullif(t.wants_target_pct, 0))) / w.n))), 'FM999999990') as "Spare",
  case when w.needs_spend is null then null
       when (w.needs_spend + w.others_needs) / nullif(t.needs_target_pct, 0) >= (w.wants_spend + w.others_wants) / nullif(t.wants_target_pct, 0) then 'Needs' else 'Wants' end as "Set by"
from w cross join t
order by w.n
